 Incidents reported on separate Chicago flights
 A passenger became disruptive on a United Airlines flight from Tokyo to Chicago on Wednesday, officials said, while a flooding incident also forced a separate flight to make an emergency landing in Chicago. Kris Van Cleave has more details.
